newsitem.title: USA: Endocare says suit without merit.
newsitem.headline: Endocare says suit without merit.

text.p: Endocare Inc said a lawsuit filed by Cryomedical Sciences Inc against it and chief executive officer, Paul Mikus, is without merit.

The November 27 suit alleges that Zhao Hua Chang, a former employee of Endocare and Endocare engaged in unfair competition against Cryomedical and misappropriated trade secrets and confidential information.
A temporary restraining order was issued by the Circuit Court for Montgomery County, Md., against Chang and Endocare to prevent disclosure at a certain cryosurgery conference.
Endocare said the order expired February 3. It said it intends to defend the lawsuit vigorously.
